body.name: \(\mathcal W^{(2)}\)
body.construction: Set \(N=8\), \(T=3\), \(r=1\), \(K=2\), \(G_i=2\) for \(i=1,\ldots,4\), and \(G_i=\infty\) for \(i=5,\ldots,8\). Set \(x_i=1\), \(z_t=1\), and \(\sigma_{it}^2=1\) for every cell. Thus \(I_2=\{1,2,3,4\}\), \(J_{2,0}=J_{2,1}=\{5,6,7,8\}\), \(S_2=\{1\}\), and \(N_0=N_1=4\). Apply the displayed coefficient formula for \(c_{kq}\) at \(k=0,1\).
